d: It took me a while but I finally completed the translation of this doujinshi. It's a passion project and was done by only one person which is me. I loved this doujin so much that I picked it up and decided to translate it. There are currently three volumes and the fourth volume is expected to come out in May 2026. I am most excited to translate volume 3 which is my favorite volume so far. Thank you guys for reading my translation.
